message: Someone broke into my car last night and stole my laptop and camera. About 3200 dollars worth. I filed a police report this morning.
reply: Thank you for reporting the theft incident last night. We have created claim #5 for your theft loss and found no similar prior claims on file. Since your claim qualifies for fast-track processing, it will be routed through expedited handling. Please submit the police report and an itemized list of stolen items with their values when convenient.
